description: Search and page the public three.ws skills catalog — reusable tools and capabilities agents can install. Filter by free-text query and category, choose a sort order, and get back a list of skills (id, name, slug, description, category, tags, install count, rating, per-call price, author, content preview) plus a cursor for the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

limit.description: How many skills to return (1–50, default 20).

q.description: Free-text search across skill name, description, and tags.

sort.description: Sort order: "popular" (default, by install count), "new" (most recent), or "az" (A–Z).

name: browse_skills
title: Browse the skills catalog
